body:
## ProtectUitem - Never Lose Your Items on Death Again!
Ever died in a dangerous spot and lost your valuable gear to other players, hoppers, or explosions? ProtectUitem solves this! It creates a temporary, unbreakable protection on your dropped items, ensuring only you can retrieve them.
A floating timer above the items shows exactly how long the protection will last, so you can plan your retrieval mission without stress.

## Key Features:
- Owner-Only Protection: Only the player who died can pick up their items.
- Configurable Timer: Set the protection duration in hours (default: 3 hours).
- Floating Hologram: A timer floats above the items, counting down the remaining protection time.
- Robust Defense: Protected items cannot be picked up by hoppers, moved by pistons, or destroyed by explosions (e.g., TNT, Creepers).
- Death Coordinates: The plugin instantly messages the player their death coordinates.
- Death History: Use the /whereideath command to see a list of your recent death locations.
- Highly Configurable: Almost every aspect, including all messages and timings, can be customized in the config.yml file.
- Localized: All messages support Russian and English and automatically adapt to the player's client language.
